attack: The opposing USD-down, CAD-up and NZD-up cases all smuggle a second currency into a view that the packet already expressed against the dollar. FACT: USDCAD +1.74% 1m / 87th 5y percentile and NZDUSD -3.90% 1m / 8.6th 5y percentile have already paid the post-FOMC USD premium; AUDUSD has not (+0.20% 1m, 84th 5y percentile) while Australian housing physicals are breaking. INFERENCE: value-guy, rate-hawk, catalyst-junkie and perma-bull are allowed a CA-US 5Y rates RV; they are not allowed to relabel that RV as CAD-higher spot. Their own residual screen (USDCAD vs CA-US 2Y, r-squared about 0.022), the +140bp 2Y USD-over-CAD carry, near-target Canadian core, cooler CA labor and a reduced oil-supply tail all say short USDCAD is the dirty translation. Cross-merchant and vol-convexity concede the AUDNZD extreme is NZD-versus-USD underperformance, then ask the room to net out USD and go long the washed, labor-soft, yield-unobservable NZD leg. That is exactly the unnecessary second-order risk this seat exists to refuse. Perma-bull’s 2s10s steepener can be a curve debate without implying USD-down: August CPI kept the tightening path live, US 2Y already cheapened 57bp in a month, and BoJ/BoE-dissent broadened G10 tightening. Fading USD after EUR, GBP, NZD and CAD have already moved is fading known information and ignoring the one G10 USD pair that has not.
defense: Keep short AUDUSD unchanged. FACT: the Fed hike is delivered but the path is not retired; AU housing/labor/activity are at or below the US analogs; AUDUSD is the lagging USD pair. CAD can have higher rates without CAD-up FX: USDCAD has already moved and 2Y carry still favors USD, which is why ca_rates_view stays higher and cad_view stays lower. NZD stays lower because the 1m wash was USD bid, not a NZ GDP miss waiting to reverse; NZ labor 47.0 / unemployment 5.6% and missing NZ yields make long NZD versus USD or versus AUD an unhedgeable residual. A cross (AUDNZD or AUDCAD) keeps the valid AUD-down delta and adds a CAD or NZD long the packet does not support in spot. UNKNOWN: positioning/flow; executable broker prices; whether AUD commodity beta offsets housing; whether BoC pass-through ever leaves core; NZ official yields.
holes_in_opposing_case: CAD-up seats (value-guy, rate-hawk, catalyst-junkie, perma-bull) translate a CA-US 5Y rates gap into CAD-higher FX even though they themselves mark USDCAD vs CA-US 2Y as a weak residual (r-squared about 0.022). FACT: USDCAD has already paid +1.74% over 1m and sits at the 87th 5y percentile; 2Y USD-over-CAD is about +140bp, so short USDCAD fights carry on a pair that is not the lagging USD expression.

BoC energy pass-through is still only a named conditional, not a CAD-up spot catalyst. FACT: CPI-trim 1.9% and CPI-median 2.0% are near target; August employment was -42k, unemployment 6.4%, wages +2.0% y/y; the Saudi-Oman workaround reduced the extreme oil-supply tail. Paying CA 5Y can be a rates RV. It does not license fading an already-moved USDCAD.

Cross-merchant and vol-convexity's own decomposition is that AUDNZD's 1m +4.27% / 5y z 3.12 is NZD underperformance versus a still-bid dollar, not independent AUD strength. Netting out USD therefore discards the primary factor and leaves an implicit long-NZD residual. That is second-order risk, not a cleaner isolation.

NZDUSD has already paid: -3.90% over 1m, 8.6th 5y percentile, through a Q2 GDP beat and an India FTA. Long NZD (perma-bull's spot candidate; the long-NZD leg of short AUDNZD) fades a completed USD move and fights the weakest labor gauge in the set (NZ 47.0, unemployment 5.6%). Official NZ yields are unavailable, so AUDNZD carry and AU-NZ rate RV cannot be risk-matched.

Perma-bull maps a 1y-window 2s10s flatten into USD-down. FACT: the same packet shows 5y 2s10s percentile 54%, so this is not 5y cheapness; August CPI kept the Fed tightening bias intact; US 2Y is +57bp over 1m at the top of its distribution; BoJ hiked to 1.25% and BoE held 6-3 with three hike votes. Curve re-steepening can occur with USD still bid. Expansionary ISM/credit does not cancel a delivered G10 tightening premium.

Value-guy's USD-down is an over-translation of receive-US 5Y / pay-CA 5Y. A Canada catch-up in yields can leave USDCAD higher if the USD policy premium and 140bp 2Y carry remain the FX constraint. Relative-rate convergence is not a USD-spot fade.

AUDUSD remains the unexpressed USD pair. FACT: AUDUSD +0.20% over 1m at the 84th 5y percentile versus EURUSD -1.89%, GBPUSD -2.07%, NZDUSD -3.90% and USDCAD +1.74%, while NSW stamp duty -24% y/y, transactions -18% and Sydney/Melbourne values more than 7% below peak. Stretch in AUDNZD or CA-US 5Y is not that residual. Carry-is-king's CAD-up synopsis overclaims a rates RV they already rejected in AUDCAD spot.

expression_comparison.rationale: Dedicated USD-spot seat. The discrepancy is that AUDUSD has not repriced the delivered USD policy premium and the Australian housing/tightening-channel break; that lives in the USD pair. A rates sleeve (US outright duration or AU-US 2Y RV) owns yield levels that are already historically extreme and does not harvest the FX lag. A cross such as AUDCAD adds CAD oil, BoC energy-pass-through and stronger Canadian activity as second-order risk on an Australia-versus-USD view.

revised_trade.invalidation: Thesis fails if AUDUSD resumes higher because US inflation/labor temperatures roll over and the Fed tightening bias is withdrawn, or if Australian housing and labor evidence reverse into a re-acceleration that restores RBA hawkish relative-rate support versus the US. Wrong-timing, not wrong-thesis, if global USD bid pauses but AU housing physicals and US policy bias remain intact.
revised_trade.mispricing: AUDUSD still trades as if Australian financial-conditions damage and the delivered USD tightening premium were comparable to a flat 1m outcome. The pair remains statistically rich (5y 84th percentile) while US front-end yields have already repriced hard and other USD pairs have already moved. The 2Y sovereign differential only mildly favors AUD (about +26bp, carry ratio 0.049) so the FX lag is not explained by a large AUD carry cushion; it is unexplained residual USD-underpricing versus AUD.
principal_risks: FOMC was already >90% priced; buying USD solely on the hike is stale unless the path and the AUD lag remain the live gap.
AU 2Y 4.999% versus US 2Y 4.76% and AU 10Y 5.348% versus US 10Y 5.01% mean rate differentials do not independently favor short AUDUSD; a relative AU hawkish re-steepening would squeeze the short.
AUD commodity/terms-of-trade beta into the energy shock is not quantified here and can bid AUD independently of housing.
US consumer temperature 48.5 with weaker confidence is a USD-negative tail if it ends the Fed tightening bias.
Positioning/flow is unavailable; crowded USD-long or AUD-short ownership cannot be tested.
No executable broker prices; research/reference ECB fixes cannot be used as entries, targets or stops.
revised_trade.thesis: FACT: The Fed delivered a 25bp hike to 3.75–4.00% after August CPI kept the tightening bias intact; rate futures had already assigned greater-than-90% odds to that 25bp step, so the decision itself is largely known information. FACT: US 2Y is 4.76% (1y z 2.84, +57bp over 1m) and US 10Y is 5.01%; the desk thesis is that BoJ’s hike to 1.25% and the BoE’s 6–33 hold with three hike votes broaden global tightening and that the energy shock is constraining the G10 easing impulse. FACT: Australian housing is showing the tightening channel in physical data—NSW stamp-duty receipts -24% y/y, transactions -18%, Sydney/Melbourne values more than 7% below peak—while AU labor 47.8 and activity 49.2 sit at or below the US analogs (labor 50.2, activity 49.92). FACT: AUDUSD research/reference fix 0.712 is still in the 84th 5y percentile (z 1.23) with a 1m return of only +0.20%, versus EURUSD -1.89%, GBPUSD -2.07%, NZDUSD -3.90% and USDCAD +1.74% over the same window. INFERENCE: The USD policy premium is being paid in other G10 USD pairs; AUD is the residual, so the clean USD-spot expression is short AUDUSD rather than chasing already-extended USDCAD or already-washed NZDUSD. INFERENCE: Cross-short AUDCAD (5y z 2.76, 99.96th percentile) mixes a valid AUD-rich observation with an implicit CAD long that imports oil, BoC energy-pass-through and Canada’s stronger activity (53.2) and consumer (52.5) temperatures—unnecessary second-order risk. UNKNOWN: Cot/positioning is unavailable; executable broker levels are not in the packet; NZ official yields are unavailable so NZD relative-rate RV cannot be completed; whether AUD’s commodity beta offsets housing stress is not identified in this freeze.
why_now: The FOMC hike is now realized, not just >90% priced, and August CPI left the Fed tightening bias intact—known decision, still-live path.
Last-24 desk thesis: BoJ 25bp to 1.25% and BoE 6–3 hold broaden tightening and keep term-rate pressure elevated even where domestic growth is softer; that is new transmission after the Fed print.
Australian housing physicals (stamp duty, volumes, home values) document the RBA tightening channel while AUDUSD has not sold off with the rest of the USD complex.
US 2Y +57bp over 1m versus AUDUSD +0.20% 1m is the live level-versus-change gap; 5d AUDUSD -0.73% is only the start of catch-down.

strongest_opposing_claim: AUDNZD at 5y percentile 99.96 / z 3.12 (and CA-US 5Y at a 0th-percentile -124bp extreme) is a larger statistical object than AUDUSD at the 84th 5y percentile, so the room should own the cross or the Canada rates RV rather than a USD pair that is not comparably stretched.
uncertainty: Cot/positioning is unavailable, so crowded USD-long or AUD-short ownership cannot be tested. Executable broker levels are absent. NZ official yields are blocked, so any AUDNZD carry argument remains an unknown, not a measured offset. AUD commodity/terms-of-trade beta into the energy shock is not quantified. US consumer temperature 48.5 is a live USD-negative tail if it retires the tightening path. BoC pass-through may never leave near-target core.
what_would_concede: Concede the USD-spot expression if AUDUSD catch-down to the already-printed EUR/GBP/NZD/CAD 1m USD moves completes while AU housing/labor re-accelerate or the Fed tightening bias is withdrawn. Concede CAD-up spot only if USDCAD reverses that 1m USD premium and 2Y carry stops favoring USD. Concede NZD-up only if NZDUSD reverses the -3.90% 1m wash with NZ labor healing and observable NZ yields showing a rate advantage that can be risk-matched. None of those falsifiers is in this freeze.
